matches.rationale: The GT defect concerns the definition/expression of the operation p⊙_t q. Finding 7 (Theorem 4.3 proof) directly addresses the defining relation for p⊙_t q, showing that the proof misstates/misapplies its expression (writing a subset relation instead of the correct derived set membership), which matches the GT's claim that the operation's definition/expression is incorrect and undermines subsequent results.
